task.title: To review a document imported from Conga Contract Intelligence

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and log into the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in.
From the Contracts pane, navigate to the Start tab and search for your imported document.
In the search results, click the arrow next to your document name to expand the entry and click Documents.
Click on the More button beside your document name and click Open.
Under the Word tab, the More button and click Review Import Results.
You can review Insights, Doc Clauses, and Doc Fields. If you do not see Doc Clauses or Doc Fields under the Work tab, click the More button from the menu.
